now: Frank Castle hunts the men behind his family's murder, and his best friend Billy Russo turns out to be one of them.
proposed: Rawlins and Billy Russo torture Frank for a password in Micro's old hideout, until Russo quietly cuts him loose and Frank kills Rawlins.
evidence: The text sums up the whole first season (Russo's betrayal is revealed in #10 at the hotel, already entry 92). In #12 the Manhattan events are Frank's confession at the Homeland Security field office and his capture and torture by Rawlins and Russo in Micro's hideout (Manhattan); Russo snips Frank's zip ties and Frank kills Rawlins.

e: Steve Rogers, a skinny kid from Brooklyn, is turned away by army recruiters again and again.
At the World Exposition of Tomorrow, Dr. Erskine overhears Steve and gives him his chance.
Steve runs out of a fake 1940s hospital room and into a Times Square seventy years later.
Ivan Vanko turns Justin Hammer's drones on the crowd at the Stark Expo.
The Hulk and the Abomination tear through the streets of Harlem.
The Chitauri pour through a portal above Stark Tower, and the Avengers fight them street by street.
Matt Murdock and Foggy Nelson open a law practice, and at night Matt puts on a mask.
Jessica runs Alias Investigations out of her apartment, until Kilgrave comes back for her.
Frank Castle wipes out gangs across the neighborhood, and Elektra pulls Matt into a war with the Hand.
Luke sweeps floors at Pop's barbershop until a shooting there pulls him into a fight for Harlem.
Danny Rand walks barefoot into Rand Enterprises, fifteen years after his family's plane went down.
Matt, Jessica, Luke and Danny trap the Hand's leaders under Midland Circle and bring the building down.
Tony Stark shows up at Peter Parker's apartment and offers him a trip to Germany.
Peter's fight with the Vulture's buyers splits the ferry in half, and Iron Man has to hold it together.
Peter brings down the Vulture's stolen cargo plane on the beach.
Fisk moves into a hotel penthouse under FBI protection and runs his operation from it.
Strange defends the New York Sanctum from Kaecilius and his zealots.
Doctor Strange gives Thor directions to Odin, after leaving Loki falling through a portal for thirty minutes.
Ebony Maw and Cull Obsidian come for the Time Stone, and Strange is taken aboard their ship.
Frank comes back to New York to finish things with Billy Russo.
The Avengers slip back into the Battle of New York to take the Tesseract and the scepter.
The Falcon and the Winter Soldier
Sam stops the Flag Smashers' attack on the Global Repatriation Council in his new suit.
Mysterio's last video plays on a giant screen, and the city learns Spider-Man is Peter Parker.
Three Spider-Men fight villains from other universes on the scaffolding around the Statue of Liberty.
Clint and Kate fight the Tracksuit Mafia around the Christmas tree at Rockefeller Center.
Doctor Strange in the Multiverse of Madness
A giant one-eyed monster chases America Chavez through the streets until Strange and Wong stop it.
In her bedroom, Kamala's bangle glows and Captain Marvel takes her place.
Young Maya sees Fisk beat a street vendor who couldn't understand her signing.
Wilson Fisk is elected mayor of New York.
The Void spreads darkness across Manhattan from the top of the old Avengers Tower.
Matt reveals in open court that he is Daredevil.
Ma Gnucci's crew attacks Frank's building, and he fights to protect his neighbors.
Jean Grey's psionic field takes over Damage Control's Roosevelt Island facility, and Peter lets her into his mind to reach her.
The team chases the Chronicoms through New York in 1931.
Steve steps out of Erskine's chamber, taller and stronger, in a lab hidden under an antique shop.
Ultron crashes the Avengers' party at Avengers Tower.
Steve fights his 2012 self, who thinks he's Loki in disguise.
Bruce talks the Ancient One into giving up the Time Stone.
Doctor Octopus attacks Peter on a bridge, and Peter realizes this Otto is from another world.
Stuck on desk duty at the SSR's New York office, Peggy takes the Zodiac mission alone and wins.
Peggy works at the SSR's New York office while secretly clearing Howard Stark's name.
Frank Castle hunts the men behind his family's murder, and his best friend Billy Russo turns out to be one of them.
Jessica digs into IGH, the company that gave her powers, and finds her mother alive.
Bushmaster comes for Mariah Dillard, and Luke ends up running Harlem's Paradise.
With the Hand gone, gangs fight over Chinatown, and Davos steals the Iron Fist.
Sallinger ties Jessica up at her apartment, but she records him confessing to Dorothy's murder and leaves him for the police. Trish kills him on his way to court.
Peter goes to Midtown School of Science and Technology and patrols the neighborhood after class.
Strange casts a spell to make the world forget Peter Parker, and it pulls in visitors from other worlds.
Kate Bishop puts on Ronin's suit at an underground auction, and Clint comes to find out who she is.
Kamala Khan starts looking out for her own neighborhood, and Jersey City gets a hero of its own.
Kamala swaps places with Carol and Monica, and the Khan family's living room becomes a battlefield.
Bullseye kills Foggy Nelson at Josie's bar.
Four years on, Spider-Man takes down Tombstone, Ramrod and Boomerang across the city.
Loki grabs the Tesseract and escapes the Avengers.
Peter works through his chores between saving people.
Fisk's Task Force locks Frank Castle and Jack Duquesne in a secret prison at the port, and Frank tricks a guard to escape.
Daredevil breaks into the Task Force prison at the port and frees the Swordsman, Soledad and the other prisoners.
Fisk runs smuggled CIA weapons through the Red Hook freeport, beyond the reach of the city's police.
Peggy sneaks into a Roxxon refinery where stolen Stark formulas are being made into bombs, and the whole plant implodes.
From his cell at Rikers, Fisk takes over the prison and sets Frank Castle on a rival inmate.
Tony and Pepper are out jogging in Central Park when Doctor Strange steps through a portal, with Bruce Banner behind him.
Peter hides May and the villains from other worlds at Happy's condo, where the Goblin returns and fatally wounds May.
Christine Palmer works at Metro-General, and she saves Strange there after a zealot wounds him at the Sanctum.
Spider-Man catches Tarantula running a smuggling job on a passenger boat near the Williamsburg Bridge.
Ward has Danny drugged and locked up at Birch Psychiatric Hospital to keep him away from Rand Enterprises.
Trish forces Dr. Malus to give her powers at a closed clinic, and he burns himself and the lab.
Damage Control takes over the Battle of New York cleanup from Toomes's crew, and years later Happy packs up Avengers Tower for the move upstate.
During the Battle of New York, young Kate Bishop sees Hawkeye leap from Stark Tower and decides to become an archer.
Back at Midtown School after his unmasking, Mr. Dell and Mr. Harrington warmly greet Peter, and Harrington shows off his Europe trip display.
Back from the Blip on the first day of the new school year, Ned spots Peter at Midtown School and they share a tearful reunion.
On the Midtown School news, Betty explains how she and half her classmates vanished in the Blip and had to restart the school year.
At Clinton Church and its orphanage, nuns nurse Matt back to health, Dex attacks Karen inside the church, and Father Lantom is laid to rest.
Father Lantom shelters the injured Matt and then Karen at Clinton Church, and is killed by Dex while shielding her.
In confession at Clinton Church, Matt admits to Father Lantom that he misses being Daredevil and has lied to Karen about it.
Presumed dead after Midland Circle falls, Matt wakes battered and bandaged in the care of nuns at the orphanage beside Clinton Church.
Matt and Karen hide out at Josie's bar, until the Anti-Vigilante Task Force surrounds it and Daredevil fights them off.
At a Harlem bar, Luke Cage grabs Turk Barrett and presses him for the man in white recruiting neighborhood kids.
Daredevil storms a Chinatown dry cleaner's that fronts for Madame Gao's heroin trade, and she tells him what she knows of the Blacksmith.
Claire signs up for classes at Colleen Wing's struggling Chikara Dojo, which becomes Danny's base in the fight against the Hand.
At a protest outside City Hall, Karen projects detainees' testimony onto its walls, and Powell kills Saunders and turns the task force on the crowd.
In 2021, Maya watches the Ronin kill her father and his Tracksuit crew, then fights Daredevil on her first job for Fisk.
Kamala Khan visits Kate Bishop and Lucky the dog at Kate's apartment to recruit her for a new team of young heroes.
Back from MIT, MJ and Ned share an apartment, and later MJ invites a masked Spider-Man inside to meet Ned.
Back at the SSR office, the agents give Peggy a standing ovation, but the government hands Thompson the credit for stopping Leviathan.
At a press conference at City Hall, the SSR clears Howard Stark's name, until shots ring out and a hypnotized police officer drives off with him, leaving Jarvis behind.
Hypnotized by Ivchenko into wearing a Stark bomb vest, Chief Dooley jumps out of the SSR office window and dies saving his agents.
Sousa exposes Peggy to Dooley, and as the SSR raids the Griffith, Angie helps her hide, until Dottie knocks her out and the agents arrest her.
Agent Krzeminski is shot dead by an unseen assassin while driving a captured guard back to SSR headquarters.
Detective Clemons guards the proof of Kilgrave's power at an old CDC facility, until a drugged Will Simpson shoots him and burns the place.
Jessica brings Ruben's head to the 15th Precinct to get herself locked up, and Kilgrave takes control of every officer in the station, Mahoney among them.
Oscar breaks things off with Jessica, telling her he has met someone else.
Trish helps Jessica hunt Gregory Sallinger, who murders Trish's mother Dorothy at her apartment.
Lewis Wilson attacks Senator Ori's fundraiser at a hotel in a bomb vest and takes Karen hostage, until Frank frees her and Lewis blows himself up. Detective Mahoney then questions the survivors.
At the Bulletin, Ellison holds back the bomber's letter until the FBI is called, then turns on the news to show Karen that Frank Castle is alive.
CIA Deputy Director Marion James tells Madani to stay out of it and let Frank and Billy Russo kill each other.
Karen confronts Fisk's fixer Felix Manning, and he threatens her with what he knows about her family.
After the attack on the Bulletin, Ellison orders Karen to name Daredevil or quit.
Dex attacks the Bulletin in Daredevil's suit and kills Jasper Evans before he can talk about Fisk.
With Matt missing, Foggy thinks about leaving the law to help his brother Theo run the family butcher shop.
Nadeem testifies against Fisk before a grand jury, but Fisk controls the jurors and the hearing changes nothing.
Back at his home, Nadeem is shot dead by Dex on the Fisks' orders.
Yelena waits for Kate in her apartment and reveals she has come to kill Clint, whom she blames for Natasha's death.
Clint and Kate trace the stolen watch to Maya Lopez's apartment, where Maya, hunting the Ronin who killed her father, attacks Kate.
Bakuto, secretly a leader of the Hand, visits Harold Meachum and offers him a partnership.

now: Jessica digs into IGH, the company that gave her powers, and finds her mother alive.
proposed: Jessica goes to complain about her neighbor Oscar's loud music, and the two end up sleeping together.
evidence: The text sums up the season's IGH hunt, and the one event it names for #6, finding her mother alive, happens at the Malus Residence, which Fandom places in New York state outside New York City, not in Hell's Kitchen. At her apartment building in #6, Jessica goes to Oscar Arocho's apartment over his loud music and they have sex.

now: With the Hand gone, gangs fight over Chinatown, and Davos steals the Iron Fist.
proposed: Danny tries to restart peace talks between the Chinatown triads, but the Golden Tigers have already seized the docks and the Hatchets are getting ready to fight back.
evidence: Davos takes the Iron Fist from Danny in a ritual at Eden Towers, an abandoned Rand Enterprises apartment building he uses as his base, not in Chinatown. The Chinatown event of #4 is Danny's failed attempt to revive the triads' peace talks after the Golden Tigers seize the docks.

e: Steve Rogers, a skinny kid from Brooklyn, is turned away by army recruiters again and again.

Steve runs out of a fake 1940s hospital room and into a Times Square seventy years later.
Ivan Vanko turns Justin Hammer's drones on the crowd at the Stark Expo.
The Hulk and the Abomination tear through the streets of Harlem.
The Chitauri pour through a portal above Stark Tower, and the Avengers fight them street by street.
Matt Murdock and Foggy Nelson open a law practice, and at night Matt puts on a mask.
Jessica runs Alias Investigations out of her apartment, until Kilgrave comes back for her.
Frank Castle wipes out gangs across the neighborhood, and Elektra pulls Matt into a war with the Hand.
Luke sweeps floors at Pop's barbershop until a shooting there pulls him into a fight for Harlem.
Danny Rand walks barefoot into Rand Enterprises, fifteen years after his family's plane went down.
Matt, Jessica, Luke and Danny trap the Hand's leaders under Midland Circle and bring the building down.
Tony Stark shows up at Peter Parker's apartment and offers him a trip to Germany.
Peter's fight with the Vulture's buyers splits the ferry in half, and Iron Man has to hold it together.
Peter brings down the Vulture's stolen cargo plane on the beach.
Fisk moves into a hotel penthouse under FBI protection and runs his operation from it.
Strange defends the New York Sanctum from Kaecilius and his zealots.
Doctor Strange gives Thor directions to Odin, after leaving Loki falling through a portal for thirty minutes.
Ebony Maw and Cull Obsidian come for the Time Stone, and Strange is taken aboard their ship.
Frank comes back to New York to finish things with Billy Russo.
The Avengers slip back into the Battle of New York to take the Tesseract and the scepter.

Sam stops the Flag Smashers' attack on the Global Repatriation Council in his new suit.

In her bedroom, Kamala's bangle glows and Captain Marvel takes her place.
Young Maya sees Fisk beat a street vendor who couldn't understand her signing.
Wilson Fisk is elected mayor of New York.
The Void spreads darkness across Manhattan from the top of the old Avengers Tower.
Matt reveals in open court that he is Daredevil.

Jean Grey's psionic field takes over Damage Control's Roosevelt Island facility, and Peter lets her into his mind to reach her.

Steve steps out of Erskine's chamber, taller and stronger, in a lab hidden under an antique shop.
Ultron crashes the Avengers' party at Avengers Tower.

Bruce talks the Ancient One into giving up the Time Stone.

Jessica digs into IGH, the company that gave her powers, and finds her mother alive.
Bushmaster comes for Mariah Dillard, and Luke ends up running Harlem's Paradise.
With the Hand gone, gangs fight over Chinatown, and Davos steals the Iron Fist.

Bullseye kills Foggy Nelson at Josie's bar.

Loki grabs the Tesseract and escapes the Avengers.
Peter works through his chores between saving people.

Fisk runs smuggled CIA weapons through the Red Hook freeport, beyond the reach of the city's police.
Peggy sneaks into a Roxxon refinery where stolen Stark formulas are being made into bombs, and the whole plant implodes.
From his cell at Rikers, Fisk takes over the prison and sets Frank Castle on a rival inmate.
Tony and Pepper are out jogging in Central Park when Doctor Strange steps through a portal, with Bruce Banner behind him.
Peter hides May and the villains from other worlds at Happy's condo, where the Goblin returns and fatally wounds May.
Christine Palmer works at Metro-General, and she saves Strange there after a zealot wounds him at the Sanctum.
Spider-Man catches Tarantula running a smuggling job on a passenger boat near the Williamsburg Bridge.
Ward has Danny drugged and locked up at Birch Psychiatric Hospital to keep him away from Rand Enterprises.
Trish forces Dr. Malus to give her powers at a closed clinic, and he burns himself and the lab.
Damage Control takes over the Battle of New York cleanup from Toomes's crew, and years later Happy packs up Avengers Tower for the move upstate.

On the Midtown School news, Betty explains how she and half her classmates vanished in the Blip and had to restart the school year.

Father Lantom shelters the injured Matt and then Karen at Clinton Church, and is killed by Dex while shielding her.
In confession at Clinton Church, Matt admits to Father Lantom that he misses being Daredevil and has lied to Karen about it.
Presumed dead after Midland Circle falls, Matt wakes battered and bandaged in the care of nuns at the orphanage beside Clinton Church.
Matt and Karen hide out at Josie's bar, until the Anti-Vigilante Task Force surrounds it and Daredevil fights them off.
At a Harlem bar, Luke Cage grabs Turk Barrett and presses him for the man in white recruiting neighborhood kids.
Daredevil storms a Chinatown dry cleaner's that fronts for Madame Gao's heroin trade, and she tells him what she knows of the Blacksmith.
Claire signs up for classes at Colleen Wing's struggling Chikara Dojo, which becomes Danny's base in the fight against the Hand.
At a protest outside City Hall, Karen projects detainees' testimony onto its walls, and Powell kills Saunders and turns the task force on the crowd.
In 2021, Maya watches the Ronin kill her father and his Tracksuit crew, then fights Daredevil on her first job for Fisk.
Kamala Khan visits Kate Bishop and Lucky the dog at Kate's apartment to recruit her for a new team of young heroes.

Agent Krzeminski is shot dead by an unseen assassin while driving a captured guard back to SSR headquarters.
Detective Clemons guards the proof of Kilgrave's power at an old CDC facility, until a drugged Will Simpson shoots him and burns the place.
Jessica brings Ruben's head to the 15th Precinct to get herself locked up, and Kilgrave takes control of every officer in the station, Mahoney among them.
Oscar breaks things off with Jessica, telling her he has met someone else.
Trish helps Jessica hunt Gregory Sallinger, who murders Trish's mother Dorothy at her apartment.

now: Wanda turns a small town into a sitcom inside a hex of red energy.
proposed: Wanda turns a small town into a sitcom inside a hex of red energy.
evidence: The hex's creation is shown in 'Previously On' (#8): after S.W.O.R.D. refuses her Vision's body, Wanda drives to the Westview lot Vision bought, makes the house and a new Vision, and spreads the hex across the town (a real memory, so sub is the year). In #4 the hex already exists; that episode shows S.W.O.R.D. finding it and Monica being thrown out. If the owner would rather keep #4 here, its event is: Monica is pulled into a hex of static around the town, and S.W.O.R.D. watches Wanda's sitcom inside until Wanda throws Monica out.

e: Wanda turns a small town into a sitcom inside a hex of red energy.
A teenager breaks Wanda's spell on Agatha Harkness and asks her to take him down the Witches' Road.
Escaping into her own backyard at the end of the Road, Agatha kisses Rio, who is Death, and dies.
Wanda gives birth to twins, Billy and Tommy.
Rio Vidal wakes Agatha from Wanda's spell, and Agatha finds her powers are gone.
Hayward tries to shoot Wanda's sons, but Monica stops him and Darcy blocks his escape. He is later arrested.
In her basement, Agatha mocks Wanda for believing the impostor "Pietro" was her dead brother.
A man calling himself Pietro, though he looks different, turns up at Wanda's door.
"Pietro" takes the twins trick-or-treating and causes mischief at super speed, until he jokes about Vision's death and Wanda blasts him aside.
"Pietro" catches Monica as she finds the way into Agnes's basement.
Billy comes back to Westview, seals the entrance to the Road, and sets out with Agatha's ghost to find Tommy.

now: A teenager breaks Wanda's spell on Agatha Harkness and asks her to take him down the Witches' Road.
proposed: Teen tells Agatha he is the one who broke Wanda's spell on her, and asks her to take him down the Witches' Road.
evidence: In #2 Teen reveals he freed Agatha and wants to walk the Road. The spell-breaking itself is not in #2: in #1 Rio helps Agnes remember who she is, and the scene of Billy breaking the spell is the #6 flashback.

now: Coulson's team hunts for a hidden alien city, and Skye is changed inside it.
proposed: Inside the alien temple under the city, the Diviner kills Trip and changes Skye.
evidence: The text sums up #31 (the team splits up and searches for the hidden city under San Juan) and #32. In #32 'What They Become', Skye and Raina follow the Diviner into the temple, Triplett is killed by it, and Skye comes out of her cocoon changed.

e: Coulson's team hunts for a hidden alien city, and Skye is changed inside it.

now: Loki and Mobius track a variant to a Roxxcart superstore days before a hurricane.
proposed: Loki and Mobius track a variant to a Roxxcart superstore where people are sheltering from a hurricane.
evidence: Not 'days before': the TVA squad goes in while the hurricane is on, and civilians are sheltering in the store, which lets the Variant hide among them.

e: Loki and Mobius track a variant to a Roxxcart superstore days before a hurricane.
Hunter B-15 takes the captured Sylvie back to the Roxxcart store, and Sylvie lets her see the life she had before the TVA.

now: Maya comes home to Tamaha, and Fisk follows her there.
proposed: Fisk's men hold Maya and Henry at Henry's skating rink, and when Maya goes back to her old home, Fisk is waiting for her.
evidence: The text sums up two episodes. Maya comes back to Tamaha in #1 ('Chafa'). In #3 ('Tuklo') Vickie and Zane hold Maya and Henry hostage at Henry's skating rink, and on her way out of town Maya goes home and is confronted by Fisk.

e: Maya comes home to Tamaha, and Fisk follows her there.

now: Bruce trains Jen at the beach lab he built with Tony.
proposed: Bruce trains Jen at his beach house lab, a hideaway Tony bought for him.
evidence: Bruce says Tony Stark bought him the place; what he and Tony built together was the bar. Nothing says they built the lab together.

e: The Eternals are forbidden to stop the slaughter of the Aztecs, and Druig breaks with Ajak.
Sam and Joaquin Torres take back stolen adamantium from the Serpent Society.
Bruce trains Jen at the beach lab he built with Tony.
Fury and Hill meet Mysterio after an Elemental wrecks a village.

now: Talos meets Gravik at a London museum, and Fury picks up the rebels' trail across the city.
proposed: Talos meets Gravik at the National Portrait Gallery to negotiate a truce, and the talks break down when Gravik threatens to kill G'iah.
evidence: In Betrayed, Gravik and G'iah meet Talos at the National Portrait Gallery in London, then move to a cafe where the parley collapses after Gravik threatens G'iah. Fury does not track the rebels across London: after meeting Talos at a pub, Fury and Talos drive to Commodore Fairbanks's house in Portsmouth to stop the missile launch.

e: The realms line up over Greenwich, and Thor fights Malekith through all of them.
Killmonger and Klaue steal a vibranium axe from a museum.
Peter fights through Mysterio's drones on Tower Bridge.
A Deviant attacks Sersi and Sprite on a London street.
Steven Grant works in a museum gift shop and keeps waking up somewhere else.
Steve recruits Bucky and the Howling Commandos over drinks in a London pub.
Steve and Sharon say goodbye to Peggy Carter at her funeral.
Talos meets Gravik at a London museum, and Fury picks up the rebels' trail across the city.
Skrull rebels ambush the President's motorcade on the way into London, and Talos dies helping Fury save him.
A hundred and twenty years after Tafari's mission, Killmonger stands before the vibranium axe in a London museum.
Loki, Mobius and B-15 find the TVA deserter Hunter X-5 living as the movie star Brad Wolfe and bring him in.
Vision walks into Paladin's trap at Saint Mabyn's Psychiatric Sanitarium, frees Tommy, and the two escape by car.

now: Jiaying fakes a S.H.I.E.L.D. attack and turns the people of Afterlife against S.H.I.E.L.D., ready for war.
proposed: Jiaying hands Cal over to Gonzales at Afterlife, then kills Gonzales and shoots herself to make it look like a S.H.I.E.L.D. attack.
evidence: The staged attack happens in #42 'Scars' (S2E20): when Jiaying and Gonzales meet at Afterlife, she delivers Cal into S.H.I.E.L.D. custody, then kills Gonzales and shoots herself to start a war. #43 'S.O.S. Part 1' only shows the people of Afterlife falling for the ruse; the current text merges the two episodes, and #43 already has its own entry here (Raina's death).

e: Skye is brought to Afterlife, a hidden Inhuman haven where Jiaying guides new Inhumans through their changes.
Jiaying leads the Inhumans of Afterlife and helps Skye learn to control her powers.
Jiaying fakes a S.H.I.E.L.D. attack and turns the people of Afterlife against S.H.I.E.L.D., ready for war.

In a changed past, Malick's men catch Coulson and Gordon slipping into Afterlife, and Malick drains Gordon's powers into John Garrett. Gordon teleports Coulson out of his cell with the last of his strength, then dies.
Jiaying kills Raina when she threatens to reveal who really started the war, and Skye, who sees it, turns against her mother.
In a changed past, Nathaniel Malick wins Kora over and takes Afterlife, and Jiaying and Gordon flee with May and Yo-Yo.

now: Agatha's coven walks the Road, one trial at a time.
proposed: Billy and Jen rejoin Agatha at the end of the Road, which turns out to be a circle, and in Agatha's trial Jen unbinds her own magic.
evidence: The entry sums up the whole journey. In episode 8 (Follow Me My Friend / To Glory at the End) Billy and Jen rejoin Agatha at the end of the Road, find it is a circle, and are taken to a version of Agatha's basement for her trial, where Jen performs an unbinding ritual and regains her abilities.

place.map: Beyond (realms and places outside normal space and time)
e: Agatha's coven walks the Road, one trial at a time.
Lilia solves the tarot trial, then flips the room so the falling swords kill the Salem Seven and herself.
At the first trial the coven drinks poisoned wine, and Sharon dies.
Alice kills the demon behind her family's curse by playing her mother's version of the Ballad.
Alice drives Evanora's spirit out of Agatha, who then drains Alice's magic and kills her.

now: Danny and Davos grow up training side by side for the title of Iron Fist.
proposed: Lei Kung names Danny the winner of his duel with Davos for the right to become the Iron Fist, though Davos never conceded.
evidence: The entry sums up their whole upbringing. The K'un-Lun flashback in S2 episode 2 (The City's Not for Burning) is the duel: Rand earns the right to the Iron Fist after Davos's father Lei Kung names him winner of a duel against Davos, though Davos had not conceded.

place.map: Beyond (realms and places outside normal space and time)
e: Danny goes back to the gate of K'un-Lun and finds it gone.
Danny and Davos grow up training side by side for the title of Iron Fist.
A War Dog steals a sacred statue from K'un-Lun, under the Iron Fist's watch.

now: Marc and Steven wake on a boat in the afterlife with the goddess Taweret.
proposed: Taweret tells Marc and Steven they are dead and sailing through the Duat on her boat, and weighs their hearts on the Scales of Justice.
evidence: Marc and Steven wake in the psychiatric hospital and meet the hippo-headed figure at the end of episode 4 (The Tomb). In episode 5 (Asylum) Taweret explains they are dead, that the hospital is a boat sailing through the Duat, and weighs their hearts.

place.map: Beyond (realms and places outside normal space and time)
e: Marc and Steven wake on a boat in the afterlife with the goddess Taweret.

now: Ka-Zar helps the powerless Xavier and Magneto, and the X-Men fight their way in to free them from Mister Sinister.
proposed: Wolverine and Ka-Zar break into Sinister's lair to free the captives, and Xavier wrecks the machine that stole their powers so the X-Men can defeat Mister Sinister.
evidence: In Reunion Part II the X-Men arrive powerless and are captured; only Wolverine escapes, teams up with Ka-Zar, and they free the prisoners. Xavier destroys the lab equipment, restoring the powers of the X-Men and Magneto, and they defeat Sinister. Ka-Zar first rescues and helps Xavier and Magneto in Part I (#25), and the X-Men do not fight their way in.

e: Stranded here and powerless, Xavier is hypnotized by Sauron, who serves Mister Sinister, into calling the X-Men into a trap.
Ka-Zar helps the powerless Xavier and Magneto, and the X-Men fight their way in to free them from Mister Sinister.
Sauron carries Storm off to the Savage Land to feed on her mutant energy, and Wolverine, Beast, Rogue and Jubilee follow.
Ka-Zar meets the X-Men again when they come to rescue Storm from Sauron.
Exodus and the Acolytes put the kidnapped Graydon Creed on trial here, and the standoff ends with Exodus dead.

now: Peter Parker takes on the Kingpin while his powers start to change him.
proposed: With his powers failing, Spider-Man walks into the Insidious Six's trap and is unmasked, and Connors tells him his mutation is the cause.
evidence: The entry sums up the season's arc. In #15 (Battle of the Insidious Six) Spider-Man walks into the Kingpin's Insidious Six trap at a warehouse, is captured and unmasked but convinces them he is a fraud, and Connors reveals he is mutating further, which is why his powers briefly vanish.

e: Peter Parker takes on the Kingpin while his powers start to change him.
The Red Skull's doomsday device turns his son Kragov into Electro, who is then lost in its vortex.
The X-Men visit the jailed Gyrich, and Jean probes his mind through Cerebro to find Bolivar Trask.
In Magneto's blackout, Daredevil stops looters until a Prime Sentinel blasts him through a window.

now: Spider-Man's team of heroes, Storm among them, defeats the Red Skull and then Doctor Doom on the Beyonder's planet.
proposed: Spider-Man's team of heroes, Storm among them, enters Doctor Doom's peaceful New Latveria to rescue the Thing, and defeats Doom after he takes the Beyonder's power.
evidence: The text sums up two episodes. The assault on the Red Skull's empire is #62 ('The Gauntlet of the Red Skull'); #63 ('Doom') opens after the Red Skull's defeat (Wikipedia: 'After defeating the Red Skull...'; Marvel Database lists the Red Skull in #63 only in flashback). #63's event: Doom kidnaps the Thing, the heroes enter his peaceful New Latveria, Doom absorbs the Beyonder, and the heroes defeat him.

e: Spider-Man's team of heroes, Storm among them, defeats the Red Skull and then Doctor Doom on the Beyonder's planet.
